CustomField.description: Visual attention indicator derived from stored compliance, severity and review fields.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Compliance_Reason_Code__c), IF(Non_Compliant__c, "⚠️ Processing Incomplete", "⚪ Not Evaluated"), IF(Reviewed__c, "✅ Review Completed", IF(AND(Non_Compliant__c, TEXT(Severity__c) = "CRITICAL"), "🚨 Immediate Action", IF(AND(Non_Compliant__c, TEXT(Severity__c) = "HIGH"), "⚠️ Priority Review", IF(Non_Compliant__c, "🔎 Review Required", IF(TEXT(Severity__c) = "CRITICAL", "👁 Critical — Compliant", "✅ No Action Required"))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows the highest-priority action currently required for this change.
CustomField.label: Attention
